metadata.title: Cathie Wood Snaps $9.5 Million on Palantir Stock During Market Selloff

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Cathie Wood's ARK Invest bought more Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) shares on Tuesday, using the market pullback to add to one of its larger artificial intelligence positions. ARK purchased 81,254 Palantir shares across three ETFs, worth about $9.48 million based on Tuesday's close.
Palantir has become a meaningful holding for ARK. As of Wednesday, the stock ranked as the 16th-largest position in the ARK Innovation ETF at 2.58% of assets, and it held a similar spot in ARK Next Generation Internet at 2.41%. In the ARK Fintech Innovation ETF, Palantir was the eighth-largest holding at 3.94%.
The buying came as Wood added to several AI-related names, but Palantir stood out because of its role in software and data analytics. ARK's move suggests Wood still sees room for the company's AI business to grow even after the stock's strong run.
Palantir remains one of the key names in ARK's speculative growth basket, and the latest purchase adds another signal that Wood is still leaning into the company's long-term AI story.
